comments:
636c7922:  ;
 ;DGJOPRT2 is the main entry point routine for printing
 ;special patient/date registers.
 ;It processes each successive date and produces
 ;a packet of output for one or more enrollees.
 ;
 ;It calls VA Date routine to select dates, VA Print Population routine
 ;to select patients, then DGJOPRT3 to get enrollment and scheduling
 ;data from MAS/PCE, combine with patient info, and output to
 ;spooled printer.
c75583a6: ;Loop until done processing all dates and patients
37279c90: ;If data was stored in ^UTILITY, retrieve it and output to spooled printer
d369f82d: Quit the routine if nothing has been passed.
6df5e732: Set variable DGJTDV1 to the value of DGJTDV.
d371b161: Get the division pointer for the division passed in DGJTDV1. If there is a deletion date associated with the division, print the 9th piece of the deletion date.
0c4b0f31: Quit the DATE subroutine.
6dfbbb5f: Format the date in DGJTDT and remove any spaces from the formatted date string.
e7f8cbc4: Loop through all patients in the VAS global for the division DGJTDV and call PAT1 for each one.
b5bc8a8d: Quit the PAT subroutine.
f875333d: Loop through all patient/insurance number combinations for the current patient and division. If the insurance number exists in the VAS(393 global, call PRT2.
124d8136: Quit the PAT1 subroutine.
f1034ebb: Print header if first physician.
3b5c42c9: Loop through patients and call PHY1 for each patient.
c17d5ba7: Exit routine.
7f8b8cf8: Set variables from VA Scope file, print detail, and call PH routine.
b56b717c: Exit routine.
b8218210: ;Loop through all patients in the utility global for the date/division.
b9c0e9fc: ;Exit loop.
b98ff8be: ;Process data for each patient/encounter.
ebfbd5ab: ;Exit subroutine.
3e1536fc: ;Print header if not already printed.
a7655fee: ;Loop through each service and service/specialty for the division, printing additional headers and processing encounters.
0ba2dcfb: ;Exit routine.
d6617db5: Loop through each patient for the specified treating specialty, service, and treatment provider.
11a131f6: Exit the loop when no more patients are found.

33a4e404: For each patient, loop through their encounters with the specified treating specialty, service, and treatment provider. If the encounter is found in the VAS global, print the encounter details and save the encounter data.
7a193eb9: Exit the inner loop when no more encounters are found.
713ebdf3: ;Set the local variable DGJTNODE to the value stored in the 0 node of the entry in file #393 with the internal entry number IFN.
7f8b1ef5: Display the physician's name if it is available, otherwise display 'NOT SPECIFIED'.
dae82564: If the line type is 'DAT', write a new line and print the date column header.
51eb941d: If the line type is not 'DAT', write a new line.
bba8e23d: Write the first 15 characters of the patient's name.
21784192: Display the patient's ID number and, if the line type is 'DAT', print it at column 30, otherwise print it at column 18.
b6ced931: If the line type is not 'DAT', extract the date from the node and print it at column 26 after writing the date.
49c3e337: ;Print the disability type
9c12b016: ;Print the service connected facility
7e9bee6f: ;Display date and time of latest record in VSIT
9fdea31a: ;Display patient
19d96c17: ;For type 'PHY' give report header and quit
75ab1882: ;Display treating physician
8ce9250a: ;Display admission type if available, otherwise blank
86a83609: ;Write the first 10 characters of the procedure name if the .01 field of the 393.2 node is populated.
dae8a684: ;Print the length of stay for the transfer.
60e3f8fe: ;Exit the routine.
d6ea2b92: Device handler entry point for screen display
8de076eb: If the device is not a terminal or it is a "DAT" or "PAT" transmission, go to RET1 label
a14f80e5: If the device is not a terminal, quit
00037f32: Clear the screen for terminal devices
c995fca9: Draw a divider line on the screen
acc1a619: Prompt the user to continue or quit, set flags accordingly
69ee2bb5: If a new page is needed and it's a "DAT" or "PAT" transmission, go to RET label, otherwise display a new header
247bc31b: If a new page is needed and it's not a terminal device, go to RET label if allowed, otherwise display a new header
950b3234: Exit point
46d6f0f0: Prints the division on the terminal.
c3bd9377: Prints the physician on the terminal.
9b900e45: Prints the service on the terminal.
b5e1125d: Prints the specialty on the terminal.
4836a5ad: Calls the PH^DGJOPRT3 routine to perform a task related to the physician.
65513825: Calls the SV^DGJOPRT3 routine to perform a task related to the service.
